title: NANSEN data variable
description: A named piece of an entity's data: where its file is, and which file adapter reads and writes it. Reading finds the file through the DSM file pattern of the entity's level (filePattern), or else at subfolder/fileName in the entity's folder. Writing puts it at subfolder/fileName in the entity's folder, which is generated by DSM when the entity has none in the location yet.

filePattern.description: Name of a DSM filePatterns entry at the entity's level in that location; reading uses the files the scan matched to it. A generated fileName must match the pattern, so what is written is found again.

subfolder.description: Folder inside the entity's folder, '/'-separated, without leading or trailing '/'.

fileName.description: File name template; {field} tokens are filled from the entity's values (key, attributes, authored columns).

dataType.description: What the adapter returns, e.g. 'ImageStack' or 'RoiArray'. Informational.
